import parse
from datetime import time

t530 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-5 * 60 - 30, '-5:30')
print('t530:', t530)
print('t530._name:', t530._name)
print('t530._offset:', t530._offset)

# Test parsing -530
r = parse.parse('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b')
print('Parsed result:', r)
print('tzinfo:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo)
print('tzinfo._name:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo._name)
print('Equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo == t530)
"
